Four timed 50-question mock tests, each set out as a paper of its own with no answer links, let you measure your progress without interruption. An answer sheet, a score tracker with an error log, and a 200-term glossary that links back to the questions. Tap Answer to jump to the explanation and tap back to return to the question. Who it is for Engineering graduates new to ML, working engineers preparing for interviews, and anyone who wants to check what they really know before relying on it.
